plain.li: [task,warm,winover] Your letters are read aloud at our table, {WRITER}. Keep them coming.
[task,warm,winover,theirLowtech] It is good to have a neighbor who writes as a friend writes.
[task,cordial,winover] We are glad of the news, and of the trouble you take to send it.
[task,cordial,winover,call] Good to hear your voice again, {WRITER}. Call whenever you like.
[task,cordial,winover,theirHightech] Received and appreciated. We'd like to keep this line open.
[task,cool,winover] We have your letter. You write often, for neighbors who have met so little.
[task,curt,winover] We read it. There is not much to answer.
[task,warm,trade] Your goods would sell well here. Tell us what you could spare, and what you'd take for it.
[task,cordial,trade] We could use what you make, and we have things you might want in return.
[task,cordial,trade,theirLowtech] Our market would be glad of your goods, if the road stays safe.
[task,cordial,trade,theirHightech] Send a manifest and we'll send ours. Prices to be agreed.
[task,cool,trade] Perhaps. Our traders go where the profit is, and they will judge yours.
[task,cordial,bringhome] Your person is alive and fed. We are not unreasonable about a price.
[task,cool,bringhome] We hold who we hold. Make an offer worth hearing.
[task,cool,bringhome,theirLowtech] The one we hold eats what our own people eat, which is more than others would give.
[task,cordial,theirkin] Thank you for word of our people. Their families will be glad to hear they live.
[task,cool,theirkin] We will want them back, and we will say what we can pay.
[task,warm,keepfaith] It is a comfort to know the same prayers are said at your table.
[task,cordial,keepfaith,theirLowtech] We keep the old rites here as you keep them there. That counts for something.
[task,cool,speakfaith] You write well about what you believe. We have our own ways and keep to them.
[task,cordial,speakfaith] Some of what you write stays with us longer than we expected.
[task,warm,host] Name the day and we will come, and we will not come empty-handed.
[task,cordial,host] A feast sounds well. Our people would be glad to sit at your table.
[task,cool,host] We may come, if the season allows it.
[task,curt,pressed] You will have your silver. Do not write to us again about this.
[task,curt,pressed,theirLowtech] We know now what kind of neighbor you are. The silver will come.
[task,curt,pressed,call] Fine. You'll get your payment. This conversation never happened.
[task,refusal,pressed] Say what you like, to whom you like. We will not be bled by you.
[task,refusal,pressed,theirLowtech] Tell it, then. We will remember who carried the tale.
[greetings,warm,us:task,task:writes] {OFFICER} writes to us so often that we look for the messenger now.
[greetings,cordial,us:task,task:writes] Our thanks to {OFFICER}, who keeps us better informed than our own people.
[news,cordial,us:task,task:visited] Here is our news. {OFFICER} will have told you some of it already, from the visit.
[soundask,us] Sit with me a while, I'd like to hear how things are with your people.
[soundask,us] You must hear a great deal, coming and going as you do.
[soundask,us,theirLowtech] Tell me about your town, I've never seen it.
[soundask,us,theirHightech] What's the talk back home these days?
[soundtalk,us] And how does your head get on with the rest of them?
[soundtalk,us] I'd heard something like that, but not the half of it.
[soundtalk,us] Go on, I'm listening.
[soundtalk,them] I shouldn't really say, but everyone knows anyway.
[soundtalk,them] You ask a lot of questions, you know that?
[soundtalk,them] There is always talk, wherever people gather.
[pressyes,them] You'll have it, and then we're done with each other.
[pressyes,them] Keep your voice down, I'll pay.
[pressno,them] Tell whoever you like, I won't be bled for it.
[pressno,them] Do your worst, I'll do mine.
[keepercaught,them] I know what you were asking about, and why.
[keepercaught,them] Pry into my affairs again and see what it gets you.
[keepercaught,them,theirLowtech] Where I come from, a sneak is shown the door.
[keepercaught,them,theirHightech] I'll be watching what I say around your people from now on.
[keeperwatch,us] I'll just see that our guests have everything they need.
[keeperwatch,us] Late night for a walk, but someone should keep the guests company.
[keeperwatch,us] I'll be out by the guests for a while.
[patrol,us] All the way round and nothing moving but the birds.
[patrol,us] Edges are clear this morning.
[patrol,us] Quiet out there, the way I like it.
[patrol,us,cold] Cold walk, but the edges are clear.
